title: Account switcher
summary: The menu a long press on the Você tab opens (ADR 0135): every account on this phone with a check on the current one, then Nova conta (ADR 0086, bipe-chat/bipe#445).

accounts.description: Every account on this phone, oldest first.

canAddAccount.description: true while the phone holds fewer personal accounts than max_accounts (bipe-api GET /v1/me/account, fallback MAX_PERSONAL_ACCOUNTS in the registries). account-new turns its personal row off when false; Nova conta shows either way, for a company account or an existing one.

switchAccount.effect: Closes the menu and runs app-tabs switchAccount.

newAccount.effect: Closes the menu and opens account-new. The accounts on the phone stay signed in.

notes: Each row shows the avatar, the display name and the @handle; never the Matrix ID.
An account with unread messages shows a dot in its row.
Company accounts do not count against the cap (ADR 0086).

Avatars show the actual account photo or initials; company accounts use rounded squares and personal/unknown accounts circles (ADR 0132). Selecting the current account dismisses the menu without a switch haptic.

Company accounts made on this phone show under their owner (bipe-chat/bipe#444): each owner with its company accounts is one group, in the order of the owner; a company without an owner on this phone keeps its own place. A company row shows bipe_account_company_owner with ownerName under its name. The owner is a phone-side grouping only (AccountList, next to the account order): no API field and no other person sees it (ADR 0138 rules 2, 5 and 7).
